task.title: Enabling repository mirroring for Red Hat Quay
task.shortdesc: To enable repository mirroring in Red Hat Quay, you can set FEATURE_REPO_MIRROR to true in your config.yaml file and restart the registry.

step.cmd: To enable mirroring for repositories, set FEATURE_REPO_MIRROR: true in your config.yaml file:

info.codeblock: # ... FEATURE_REPO_MIRROR: true REPO_MIRROR_INTERVAL: 30 REPO_MIRROR_SERVER_HOSTNAME: "openshift-quay-service" REPO_MIRROR_TLS_VERIFY: true REPO_MIRROR_ROLLBACK: false FEATURE_SPARSE_INDEX: true REPO_MIRROR_MAX_MANIFEST_LIST_SIZE: 10485760 REPO_MIRROR_MAX_MANIFEST_ENTRIES: 1000 # ...

dlentry.dd: Specifies whether to enable or disable repository-level mirroring.
Specifies the worker processing interval in seconds.
Specifies the hostname of the server hosting the mirrored repository.
Specifies whether to verify the TLS certificate of the mirrored repository.
Specifies whether to roll back the repository if a mirroring operation fails.
Specifies whether to allow sparse manifest indexes.
Specifies the maximum size of the manifest list in bytes.
Specifies the maximum number of manifest entries to process.

step.cmd: Restart your Red Hat Quay registry.
